The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group [[Telak's Terrors]] maintained a '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltaya Minor]] in the [[Ropagi system/Legends|Ropagi system]]. It was located one hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] below the surface, and was [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and energy shielded, making it virtually undetectable. The base complement included 36 [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], 20 base security/boarding forces, 18 ground support [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] and mechanics, 16 [[Droid/Legends|droids]], 48 [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], and assorted concubines.
